NCT01824290.why: tadalafil against placebo in children. BOSENTAN IS NOT RANDOMISED. It is named as an EXAMPLE OF A CLASS in a background-therapy record attached to BOTH arms: "All participants were taking endothelin receptor antagonist (ERA) (such as bosentan, ambrisentan and macitentan)."

NCT04273945.why: macitentan 75 mg against macitentan 10 mg. BOSENTAN IS NOT RANDOMISED. It is named in the arm description as a PRIOR EXPOSURE participants must come off: "...or a daily dose of bosentan <250 mg, will enter a 4-week open-label run-in period with macitentan 10 mg prior to randomization." The identical sentence appears in BOTH arms.

the_mechanism_both_flagged_trials_share: A DRUG NAMED IN AN ARM DESCRIPTION AS PRIOR THERAPY, BACKGROUND THERAPY OR AN EXAMPLE OF A CLASS IS NOT THE RANDOMISED INTERVENTION. `locate()`'s step-1 scan reads arm DESCRIPTIONS while its control-arm test reads intervention NAMES only -- an asymmetry built deliberately for DAPA-HF, whose control record is named `Drug: Placebo` with the description 'Placebo matching dapagliflozin'. The consequence here is that a description-only mention counts as presence in an arm and THE SAME MENTION ON THE CONTROL SIDE CANNOT CANCEL IT. Where the mention is IDENTICAL IN EVERY ARM it is by construction not the contrast, whichever field it sits in.

withholding_question.question: does each eligible trial register, at ANY rank, a six-minute walk distance CHANGE, or a clinical-worsening / morbidity-mortality outcome, before any decision about which trials can be combined?
withholding_question.detected_structurally_not_by_keyword: a walk-distance term plus a change term; a worsening or event term in a disease context. Never a registered phrase, which would find only the trials that already agree.
